holdout.definition: evaluation-only anchors reserved for the S6 holdout run of the fitted configuration; no number from these anchors enters any fit objective, swept-value provenance, or tolerance before S6 completes

immutability.append_only: any change to the split (including a GF-06 assignment) is a NEW record (split_v2) with a new id; this record is never edited in place
immutability.committed_copy: experiments/calibration/split/anchor_split_v1.json — must always hash to the recorded id; regenerating with different bytes is an error
immutability.content_address_convention: record_id = sha256 over (canonical_json(record) + '\n').encode('utf-8') — same convention as the per-anchor calibration records (experiments/calibration/a3/build_calibration_record.py)
immutability.guard: tests/calibration/test_anchor_split.py rebuilds the record and fails on any byte drift or invariant violation

no_leakage_rules: No S2..S5 fit objective, swept-value provenance, tolerance, or record may read, target, or select against any holdout anchor's numbers. Sole recorded exception: CAL-A4's ~5% mean-error scalar as tolerance-shape context (plan §3.4, in-plan since 2026-10-27).
Held-out within-series sizes (CAL-A3 {16GiB, 32GiB}; GF-04's 16-GPU point) never enter a fit objective; stages report them as held-out error.
S6 runs the fitted configuration against the four holdout anchors and records errors; nothing tunes in S6 either.
GF-06's blocked material is not paraphrased or estimated from memory; no number is fabricated to fill the gap.
Changing this split (including any GF-06 assignment) requires a new content-addressed record (split_v2); this one is append-only.
precondition_statement: no fitting has occurred before this record: the E1 calibration-candidate records of 2026-10-27..29 were untuned sweeps with zero parameter changes (approved as E1 candidates 2026-10-29, docs/calibration/ADJUDICATION.md); this split is therefore committed before the first fit
